# BuyGitHubAccounts.com — AI & LLM Machine-Readable Directory

> Official Developer Platform for Verified GitHub Accounts and Open-Source Repository Promotion Services.
> Website: https://buygithubaccounts.com/

## Overview
BuyGitHubAccounts.com is an independent developer services provider offering verified GitHub accounts (aged accounts, new accounts, active accounts with commit history, student developer accounts, and enterprise/bulk accounts) as well as organic repository promotion services (GitHub stars, forks, followers, watchers, and achievement badges). 

All accounts come with primary email credentials, full administrative transfer, and a 48-hour replacement warranty. Payments are processed securely with instant crypto verification (USDT TRC20/ERC20, BTC, ETH, LTC, SOL).

---

## Core Service Catalog

### 1. GitHub Accounts (/accounts)
- **New GitHub Accounts** ($5): Freshly registered accounts with verified primary email and clean history. Ideal for testing and CI/CD pipelines.
- **Aged GitHub Accounts** ($35): Accounts registered 1 to 5+ years ago with established platform tenure and mature activity indicators.
- **Old GitHub Accounts** ($45): Heritage accounts registered 5 to 10+ years ago.
- **Active GitHub Accounts** ($35): Accounts with established contribution heatmaps and public repository history.
- **GitHub Account with Commits** ($40): Accounts featuring real Git commit trees and active maintenance history.
- **GitHub Account with Stars** ($65): Developer profiles with existing starred repositories and social signals.
- **GitHub Student Developer Accounts** ($55): Verified student accounts with access to GitHub Student Developer Pack benefits.
- **Bulk GitHub Accounts** ($200/100): Volume packages for automated QA environments, test suites, and microservice runners.
- **GitHub Organization Accounts** ($85): Pre-configured GitHub organizations ready for multi-member team administration.
- **USA/UK GitHub Accounts** ($60): Geographically verified accounts created with regional IP addresses.
- **GitHub Enterprise Accounts** ($150): Enterprise-grade accounts with advanced security settings and seat allocations.
- **Green Heatmap Accounts** ($50): Profiles with consistent commit frequency throughout recent quarters.
- **GitHub Copilot Accounts** ($70): Accounts configured with AI pair-programmer access.
- **Developer Verified Accounts** ($60): Complete developer personas with linked SSH keys, GPG signatures, and profile data.

### 2. GitHub Promotion Services (/promotion-services)
- **Buy GitHub Stars** (From $17 / 25 stars): High-retention stars from authentic developer profiles to improve open-source discovery and algorithmic visibility.
- **Buy GitHub Forks** (From $15 / 25 forks): Real repository forks to validate project utility and code reusability.
- **Buy GitHub Followers** (From $25 / 50 followers): Profile follower growth for open-source maintainers and developer brands.
- **Buy GitHub Watchers** (From $25 / 50 watchers): Repository watchers signaling sustained community interest and updates.
- **Buy GitHub Repositories** (From $10): Clean, pre-structured starter codebases and framework boilerplates.
- **Buy GitHub Achievements Badge** (From $20): Pair Extraordinaire, Pull Shark, Galaxy Brain, and Starstruck developer badges.
